recommendation: Keep the published commit as-is; it preserves the applied WG policy while removing misleading text that would point implementers to a nonexistent extension name.
issue_request: FHIR-48422 asked whether Basic should be implicitly accepted as a target for all Reference and Resource uses. FHIR-I applied a Not Persuasive with Modification resolution for R6: keep Reference target restrictions meaningful and add References.html guidance that uses the alternate-reference extension for out-of-target references, including Basic/inter-version and additional-resource cases.
initial_application: Commit 4c62878beb7f314514c3f68dd936bbdc510dc25a added the requested Additional References section before Canonical URLs in source/references.html. The current combined branch already contained that application, but the migration paragraph used the nonexistent name additional-reference and included a stray closing quote.
additional_context: FHIR-I Madrid minutes confirm the decision and identify alternate-reference as the extension for pointing to Basic or additional resources. The FHIR Extension Pack defines StructureDefinition/alternate-reference. source/fhir.ini maps the Reference type page to references.html, making the edited narrative current build-scope source.
reconciliation: Changed the migration paragraph in source/references.html to refer to alternate-reference and removed the stray quote. No broader implicit Basic allowance was added.
source_changes: source/references.html: corrected the Additional References migration paragraph from additional-reference to alternate-reference and removed the trailing quote after the transition sentence.
